svg.title: Diagonal with Curve III
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Guggenheim essayfigure3 provides a complete dark-blue diagonal support with curved upper-left edge and straight lower-right edge. Wall and display rail excluded. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=74; record guggenheim1996-essay-74-fig-3; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
